continuity.narrative_arc: Maternal concern becomes a terrifying whirlwind abduction; the village searches, Krishna is found unharmed, joy returns through the family and cowherd community, and Bhattathiri closes with a prayer for relief from disease.

continuity.palette_arc: A quiet cream-and-ochre household opens into dust-muted earth tones and maroon wind shadows; the storm resolves into warm cream daylight and gentle devotional ochre. Preserve D001 mineral palette and deep-blue infant identity without glossy highlights.

Follow the published Sanskrit for action, keep supplied commentary verbatim as editorial source, and do not invent an English translation.

supporting_character_identity.nandagopan: One recurring mature adult man; warm medium-brown complexion, gently rounded/oval face, dark moustache, dark hair gathered or covered simply; calm protective expression; simple cream dhoti with muted olive/green upper cloth or head covering; visually distinct from elderly ascetic Garga Muni and longer-haired fuller-bearded Vasudeva.
supporting_character_identity.yashoda: One recurring adult mother; warm medium-brown complexion, gentle oval face, expressive dark eyes, dark hair parted and gathered under a simple sari veil; warm cream/soft saffron or muted rose sari with restrained olive/blue accents and modest jewelry; distinct from other gopikas through consistent face, hair, veil and calm maternal presence.
